cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've cancelled the outing, following your cross on the booking form. You'll need to tell the team.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That cross selected the coach company. You copied it into the cancellation box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, the booking decision. You can explain it; you chose the company.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ring them to restore it, but you tell the team about the mistake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make that call with the team here. Then you can explain the cancellation to everyone at once.

reason: Replace vague crossed-budget-total causality with a specific booking selection copied into a cancellation field. Preserve the demand that B carry the unpleasant announcement and B's cooperative repair offer.
